etymologies.etymologyHTML: From survive +‎ -or.

definitions.definition: One who survives, especially one who survives a traumatic experience.

quote.citation: 1984 August 18, Pam Mitchell, “We Must Not Silence Our Lives”, in Gay Community News, volume 12, number 6, page 9:
quote.text: Believing that requires trust, and trust is understandably a tough issue for those of us who are survivors.

definitions.definition: (figuratively) A person who is able to endure hardship.

quote.citation: 2007, Xavier: Renegade Angel, season 1, episode 1, spoken by Xavier (Vernon Chatman):
quote.text: I'm a survivor. We're a dying breed.

definitions.definition: One who knew a specific decedent.
